title: Ritham "Dietary Pattern" Preference — Design Addendum
summary: Defines a non-gating dietary-pattern preference field, its intake question, food-swap rules, and education content layered on existing nutrition logic.
notes: No ADR/PRD frontmatter or status field present. Classified as SPEC due to explicit data model (dietary_pattern: none|vegetarian|vegan), engineer-facing implementation rules ('Rule, stated plainly for engineers implementing this'), gate-resolution logic, and swap/lookup tables — these are implementation contracts rather than user-facing requirements or a locked architectural decision. Document also contains PRD-like elements (intake question/UX copy) and DOC-like elements (nutrient education prose), but the dominant, load-bearing content is the technical rule/table specification, so SPEC was chosen per the ADR>SPEC>PRD>DOC precedence tie-break.
